Simple Memory Game is a fun and engaging memory-matching puzzle where players test their concentration and visual recall across 10 increasingly challenging levels. Each level presents a grid of cards hiding colorful fruit emojis. Players must flip the cards two at a time to uncover matching fruit pairs. The objective is simple: match all the fruit pairs in each level to progress to the next. As levels advance, the number of cards increases, demanding sharper focus and stronger memory skills. Quick recognition and strategic flipping are key to achieving the best possible score.

Instructions

Match the cards for right fruit pairs

Description

Cozy Kitchen Merge is a cute cooking puzzle where you place dishes on the tray, watch the queue, and merge 3 or more of the same dish&mdash;sides or corners both count. Each merge makes the next recipe and bumps your score. Every 100 points gives you an Eat Token. Tap the fork button to munch one dish and make space when things get tight. Keep at least one empty spot; no room for the next dish means game over. Climb the recipe ladder (1&rarr;10), unlock sweet achievements, and chase your best score. Soft art, cozy sounds, quick runs&mdash;perfect for a relaxing break. And hey, please dont wreck the game menu. Things may fall.

Instructions

Tap click an empty spot on tray to place the next dish Check the counter the dish on the right goes next Merge 3 or more of the same dish touching each other Every 100 points you get 1 Eat Token In the main menu you can tap and drag the decor
